Your order Shop···· is paid but hasn't shipped yet, and I'm sorry about that. It was due to ship November 15, and that date has slipped.

Your Power K. is already at our Netherlands warehouse. The B30 is one of the first 200 units arriving there now, as we emailed you on November 18. Both will go out together in one box, and tracking usually follows within a week.

You can follow the inbound shipment here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status. Tracking will go to the email on your order, so check your spam folder too.
